tasks.objective: You are not alone in this codebase; preserve others' edits. Own ONLY quantpilot/paper/strategy.py and quantpilot/tests/unit/test_intraday_strategies.py. No commits. Implement standalone pure offline intraday strategy/market allocation module (stdlib+pydantic already installed), without importing broker/operator or AI. Define frozen dataclass Bar(symbol:str, start:datetime, open:float, high:float, low:float, close:float, volume:float), validated timezone-aware finite positive OHLC and nonnegative volume. Define frozen dataclass Signal(strategy_id:str, symbol:str, price:float, stop:float, target:float, score:float, reason:str, version:str='1'). Public functions validate_bars(bars:list[Bar], now:datetime)->list[Bar] reject duplicate timestamps, gaps within same session, future/incomplete 1m bars (do not silently use incomplete), mixed symbols; aggregate_five_minutes(bars)->list[Bar] use only complete aligned 5m groups, no overnight groups. evaluate_strategies(bars:list[Bar], now:datetime, session_open:datetime)->list[Signal] returns valid signals only, insufficient warmup empty; three IDs opening_range_breakout (opening 15m high crossover on completed 1m close, volume confirmation), trend_pullback (completed 5m rising EMA20 pullback and recovery), range_reversion (completed 5m sideways band/RSI recovery). Freeze documented thresholds in module; stops strictly below price, targets above price, calculate ATR where needed, no shorts/no synthetic bars, no lookahead. Public allocate_weights(market_scores:dict[str,float], performance:dict[str,dict], ai_scores:dict[str,float]|None=None, cap:float=0.6)->dict[str,float]; market score normalized 0..1 dominates initial weighting, AI at most 20% score, shrink performance influence with sample count (performance keys trades, mean_r, max_drawdown), cap each strategy 60%, leave excess as cash, invalid/missing scores cannot imply success probability, unknown AI keys must not enable unknown strategies. Public select_signals(signals:list[Signal], weights:dict[str,float], occupied_symbols:set[str])->list[Signal] deterministically highest score per symbol with no occupied duplicates. Tests show actual triggers, insufficient data, lookahead, gaps, conflicting symbols, concentration caps, no forced investment when no score, NaN invalid input. Module must be independently importable without __init__ (lead creates package later).
